name: Cascade liquefaction
principle: Three pure-component refrigeration cycles in series, propane, ethylene and methane, cool the gas in steps, each in brazed aluminium exchangers or core-in-kettle units. ConocoPhillips' 'two-trains-in-one' layout puts two compressors on each refrigerant service, so the train keeps running at reduced rate when one machine trips.

performance.basis: 28 trains at 12 operating plants on the ConocoPhillips reference list

source.note: ConocoPhillips Optimized Cascade quick reference card, CS 24-0106 (2023-2024)

performance.basis: licensor claim for the two-trains-in-one configuration

advantages: Pure refrigerants are simple to make up
limitations: More compressors and refrigerant circuits than mixed refrigerant processes
Ethylene refrigerant must be imported or stored
Train size mostly 3.6 to 5.2 Mtpa (large train option 8 Mtpa)
